title: Uncovered and Disrupted BADBOX 3.0, the Largest Ad Fraud Operation by Bid Volume Ever Publicly Disclosed
description: BADBOX 3.0 is the largest ad fraud operation publicly disclosed, generating about 40 billion bid requests daily and accounting for over 4% of connected TV traffic. It targets low-cost consumer devices infected with backdoors linked to the Chinese manufacturer TXCZ. These backdoors deliver fraud modules that hide video ads, impersonate legitimate apps, and enroll devices as exit nodes in multiple residential proxy networks, including PXYEDGE. The operation also uses spoofed server-side ad insertion traffic. Its volume surpasses previous records by a significant margin.
